title: Why Some Songs Give You Goosebumps 🎧 #shorts
description:
Do you get goosebumps from music? Yes or no?
Your brain treats a surprise in a song like danger for a split second, then rewards you for it.

Sources: Radboud University; McGill University / ScienceDaily (Salimpoor et al. 2011, Nature Neuroscience)
